title: Penetration Test Infra
description:
**Senior Infrastructure Penetration Tester / Infrastructure Security Consultant – Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Infrastructure Penetration Tester
  
**Experience:** 5-10 Years (Senior) / 8-12 Years (Lead)
  
**Department:** Cyber Security / Offensive Security / Red Team

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Infrastructure Penetration Tester** to perform security assessments, vulnerability exploitation, red team exercises, and infrastructure security testing across enterprise on-premises, cloud, network, server, virtualization, and Active Directory environments.

The candidate should possess strong expertise in **Network Penetration Testing, Active Directory Security, Windows/Linux Security, Cloud Security, Red Team Operations, Vulnerability Assessment, Privilege Escalation, and Security Remediation Consulting** .

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure Penetration Testing**

* Perform internal and external network penetration testing.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and security audits.
* Identify security weaknesses across servers, networks, endpoints, and infrastructure components.
* Validate vulnerabilities through controlled exploitation.
* Perform security assessments for hybrid cloud environments.

**Active Directory Security Testing**

* Conduct Active Directory penetration testing.
* Identify privilege escalation paths and attack chains.
* Assess Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, Group Policies, and Authentication Security.
* Evaluate Tier-0 assets and privileged access security.
* Perform lateral movement assessments.

**Tools**

* BloodHound
* PingCastle
* Mimikatz
* Impacket
* Rubeus
* PowerView

**Network Penetration Testing**

* Assess routers, switches, firewalls, and network devices.
* Conduct internal and external attack simulations.
* Perform network enumeration and reconnaissance.
* Identify misconfigurations and insecure protocols.
* Assess firewall and segmentation controls.

**Technologies**

* Cisco
* Palo Alto
* Fortinet
* Check Point
* F5
* Load Balancers
* VPN Technologies

**Cloud Security Assessment**

* Perform security assessments of Azure and AWS environments.
* Validate IAM security configurations.
* Assess cloud networking and security controls.
* Review security posture and compliance gaps.
* Conduct privilege escalation testing in cloud environments.

**Platforms**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Microsoft Entra ID
* AWS IAM
* Defender for Cloud

**Operating System Security Testing**

**Windows Security**

* Windows Server Security Assessment
* Active Directory Security Review
* Group Policy Review
* Privileged Access Assessment
* PowerShell Security

**Linux Security**

* Linux hardening validation
* Privilege escalation testing
* Sudo configuration reviews
* SSH security reviews

**Vulnerability Management**

* Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated scans.
* Validate vulnerabilities identified by scanning tools.
* Perform risk prioritization and remediation recommendations.
* Assist infrastructure teams in vulnerability closure.

**Tools**

* Nessus
* Qualys
* Rapid7 InsightVM
* OpenVAS
* Nexpose

**Red Team Activities**

* Execute red team simulations.
* Emulate real-world threat actors.
* Test detection and response capabilities.
* Assess SOC monitoring effectiveness.
* Validate EDR/XDR security controls.

**Security Platforms Exposure**

* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* CrowdStrike Falcon
* SentinelOne
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Splunk

**Reporting & Remediation**

* Develop executive and technical assessment reports.
* Present findings to security leadership and infrastructure teams.
* Provide actionable remediation recommendations.
* Support security improvement initiatives.
* Conduct security awareness sessions for technical teams.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Infrastructure & Network Security**

* TCP/IP
* Routing & Switching
* Firewalls
* VPN Technologies
* IDS/IPS
* Network Segmentation
* DNS, DHCP

**Security Testing Tools**

* Burp Suite Professional
* Nmap
* Metasploit
* Nessus
* Qualys
* Wireshark
* BloodHound
* CrackMapExec
* Responder
* Impacket

**Operating Systems**

* Windows Server
* Linux Administration
* Active Directory
* VMware
* Hyper-V
* Citrix

**Scripting**

* PowerShell
* Python
* Bash
* Automation Scripting

**Cloud Security**

* Azure Security
* AWS Security
* IAM Security
* Entra ID
* Cloud Networking

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 5-10 years of experience in Penetration Testing, Red Teaming, Security Assessments, or Cyber Security Engineering.
* Strong understanding of attack methodologies and security controls.
* Experience working with enterprise infrastructure environments.

**Preferred Certifications**

**Offensive Security**

* OSCP (Highly Preferred)
* OSCE
* OSEP
* CRTO (Certified Red Team Operator)
* CRTP (Certified Red Team Professional)

**Security Certifications**

* CISSP
* CEH
* GPEN
* GWAPT
* GCIH
* CompTIA Security+

**Cloud Certifications**

* AZ-500
* AWS Security Specialty

**Key Competencies**

* Infrastructure Penetration Testing
* Active Directory Security
* Red Team Operations
* Network Security Assessments
* Vulnerability Management
* Exploitation Techniques
* Privilege Escalation
* Cloud Security Testing
* Security Architecture Review
* Technical Reporting
* Client & Stakeholder Management

**Ideal Candidate Profile (Senior Level)**

A security professional with **5-10 years of experience** in **Infrastructure Penetration Testing, Active Directory Security, Windows/Linux Administration, Network Security, VMware/Citrix, Azure/AWS Security, Vulnerability Management, Red Teaming, and Security Consulting** . The candidate should be capable of independently leading enterprise security assessments, simulating advanced attack scenarios, validating security controls, and providing strategic remediation guidance to global clients.

title: Associate - Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment - IN
description:
**Associate - Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment - IN**  
The Information Security Vulnerability Assessment Analyst job participates in conducting vulnerability assessments to protect the company's data, information systems and networks. Under close supervision, this job participates in analyses to make corrective actions and to check the intrusion paths that exist within the current systems. This job also contributes in analyzing threats or hidden events within the enterprise network.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* Assists in performing vulnerability assessments to test existing network safeguards, and employs computer network defense tools and approved practices to protect networks to ensure data security.
* Contributes in analyzing causes and exploitation methods of malicious activities, along with checking the effects on information technology (IT) systems and information.
* Assists in identifying intrusion or incident path and method for incidents found via vulnerability analysis.
* Helps making recommendations for vulnerability corrections within reports outlining past network security incidents.
* Assists in analyzing software systems to determine both functionality and intent of software systems.
* Participates in the design and development of countermeasures, system integration, and tools specific to cyber and information Operations.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* 2+ Years Required; 3+ Years Preferred

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

  
**Career Level**  
6IC  
  

**AI-Enabled Capabilities**

* Builds and matures AI-enabled vulnerability scanning capabilities using AI development tools and platforms, strengthening the team's skills and repeatable practices for AI-driven scans.
* Designs, builds, and iterates on AI-based validation agents (e.g., verification of scan findings, SAST verification) to improve accuracy and reduce false positives at scale.
* Drives the integration of AI and agentic capabilities into vulnerability management BAU, improving the speed, accuracy, and scale of identification, prioritization, and remediation workflows.
* Develops standardized evaluation criteria to benchmark performance across testing harnesses, LLM providers, and iterations, ensuring AI processes are repeatable and sustainable; supports advancement of AI identification and verification from proof-of-concept to production.
* Leads and participates in future AI-driven vulnerability management initiatives that build on these capabilities as the program evolves.

Related SkillsAccountability, Adaptability, Business Continuity Planning, Cloud Computing Security, Collaboration, Communication, Compliance, Consultative Communication, Cybersecurity, Detail-Oriented, General Risk Management, Network Security, Prioritizes Effectively

title: Red Team Consultant
description:
Job Description – Red Team Consultant / Senior Consultant

Role Overview

We are looking for passionate and highly skilled Red Team professionals to join our offensive security team. The role involves simulating advanced adversary techniques to assess, challenge, and strengthen the security posture of our clients. You will plan, execute, and report on Red Team engagements covering network, application, cloud, social engineering, and physical vectors.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Conduct full-scope Red Team engagements simulating real-world adversaries.

Perform adversary emulation using techniques aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.

Identify, exploit, and escalate vulnerabilities across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

Develop and execute phishing/social engineering campaigns.

Design and carry out lateral movement, privilege escalation, persistence, and data exfiltration scenarios.

Research and develop custom tools, scripts, and payloads to support operations.

Collaborate with the Blue Team/Purple Team for detection engineering and defensive improvements.

Document and present findings in executive and technical reports with clear risk/business impact.

Stay updated with the latest TTPs, APT campaigns, and security research.

  
  

Required Skills & Experience

3–7 years of experience in penetration testing / offensive security / Red Teaming.

Strong knowledge of network protocols, Active Directory attacks, and cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Proficiency in exploit development, scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash), and tool customization.

Hands-on with tools like Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Empire, Covenant, Sliver, Veil, Mimikatz, BloodHound, etc.

Experience with Evasion techniques (AV/EDR bypass, obfuscation, payload delivery).

Familiarity with forensic artefacts and ability to simulate stealthy attacker behavior.

Excellent problem-solving skills and an attacker’s mindset.

Good communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  
  

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

Relevant certifications: OSCP, CRTO, OSEP, OSCE, CRTP, CRTE, CISSP (offensive track).

Experience in physical Red Team assessments.

Experience with custom malware development or adversary simulation frameworks.

Contribution to open-source tools, security research, or publications.
